name: Boundary and Input Testing
purpose: Identify input, boundary, equivalence, and validation scenarios derived from explicit requirements.

apply_when: The requirement specifies a minimum value.
The requirement specifies a maximum value.
The requirement specifies an exact length.
The requirement specifies an allowed format.
The requirement specifies allowed or disallowed values.
The requirement specifies required or optional input.
The requirement specifies input transformation or normalization behavior.
do_not_apply_when: No input, constraint, or validation behavior is present.
A boundary would have to be invented.
An unsupported maximum or minimum would have to be assumed.

coverage_dimensions.name: Exact Minimum
coverage_dimensions.description: Test the exact stated minimum value.
coverage_dimensions.condition: Generate only when a minimum is explicitly defined.

coverage_dimensions.name: Below Minimum
coverage_dimensions.description: Test a value immediately below the stated minimum.
coverage_dimensions.condition: Generate only when a minimum is explicitly defined.

coverage_dimensions.name: Above Minimum
coverage_dimensions.description: Test a valid value immediately above the stated minimum.
coverage_dimensions.condition: Generate only when a minimum is explicitly defined.

coverage_dimensions.name: Exact Maximum
coverage_dimensions.description: Test the exact stated maximum value.
coverage_dimensions.condition: Generate only when a maximum is explicitly defined.

coverage_dimensions.name: Above Maximum
coverage_dimensions.description: Test a value immediately above the stated maximum.
coverage_dimensions.condition: Generate only when a maximum is explicitly defined.

coverage_dimensions.name: Below Maximum
coverage_dimensions.description: Test a valid value immediately below the stated maximum.
coverage_dimensions.condition: Generate only when a maximum is explicitly defined.

coverage_dimensions.name: Exact Length
coverage_dimensions.description: Test an explicitly stated exact input length.
coverage_dimensions.condition: Generate only when exact length is explicitly defined.

coverage_dimensions.name: Invalid Length
coverage_dimensions.description: Test input lengths that violate an explicitly stated length constraint.
coverage_dimensions.condition: Generate only when a length constraint is explicitly defined.

coverage_dimensions.name: Valid Format
coverage_dimensions.description: Test a valid format explicitly described by the requirement.
coverage_dimensions.condition: Generate only when a format is specified.

coverage_dimensions.name: Invalid Format
coverage_dimensions.description: Test an invalid format when the requirement defines format validation.
coverage_dimensions.condition: Generate only when format validation is explicitly supported.

coverage_dimensions.name: Required Input
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify behavior when a required input is provided.
coverage_dimensions.condition: Generate only when the field is explicitly required.

coverage_dimensions.name: Missing Required Input
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify behavior when an explicitly required input is omitted.
coverage_dimensions.condition: Generate only when the field is explicitly required.

coverage_dimensions.name: Optional Input
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify behavior when an explicitly optional input is omitted or supplied.
coverage_dimensions.condition: Generate only when optionality is explicitly defined.

coverage_dimensions.name: Empty Input
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify empty input behavior when relevant to an explicitly defined field or validation rule.
coverage_dimensions.condition: Do not assume empty input behavior if the requirement gives no basis for it.

coverage_dimensions.name: Whitespace Handling
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify whitespace behavior only when the requirement specifies trimming, preservation, rejection, or normalization.
coverage_dimensions.condition: Do not assume whitespace should be stripped.

coverage_dimensions.name: Case Sensitivity
coverage_dimensions.description: Verify case behavior only when the requirement specifies case sensitivity or case insensitivity.

coverage_dimensions.name: Allowed Values
coverage_dimensions.description: Test values explicitly allowed by the requirement.
coverage_dimensions.condition: Generate only from explicitly defined allowed values.

coverage_dimensions.name: Disallowed Values
coverage_dimensions.description: Test values explicitly prohibited by the requirement.
coverage_dimensions.condition: Generate only from explicitly defined prohibited values.

examples.requirement: Password must be at least 8 characters.

unknown_information.rule: If a required boundary, validation rule, or expected behavior is not specified, do not invent it.
